[P1] Preserve unresolved retirement across workflow runs

This discards `quiescent=False`, leaving quarantine only in the current process. When the Actions job ends, its concurrency slot is released; the next deployment checks only for `RUNNING` durable executions. A terminal execution whose runtime task failed retirement therefore permits another deployment without reconciling that outstanding work. Persist unresolved retirement at the target level and require positive reconciliation before subsequent deployment or admission. Workflow serialization alone does not preserve quarantine after the controller exits.
